title: Double Drip Blueberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Blueberry Sour Raspberry offers a sharp and fruity flavour experience that strikes a perfect balance between sweet and tart. Juicy Blueberry notes provide a soft, jammy base, while Sour Raspberry brings a bold tang that adds a deliciously edgy tang and bite. The result is a punchy fruit blend with a smooth, clean finish and syrupy sweetness, ideal for vapers who enjoy a more vibrant profile. This nicotine salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits such as pod devices, vape pens, and starter kits. It offers a smooth throat hit, discreet vapour, and clear, consistent flavour — ideal for daily use. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
